apps.title: Bendy's Nightmare Run
apps.summary:
Bendy's Nightmare Run is back!

Run as Bendy, Boris, or Alice in a nightmare-fueled endless runner where the goal is simple: survive the chase and defeat crazy cartoon bosses.

RUN FROM TROUBLE

Dash through four themed episodes filled with enemies, obstacles, collectibles, weapons, and powerups. Swipe left and right to move, swipe up to jump or double jump, and swipe down to slam onto enemies as you race away from increasingly difficult bosses.

Collect Bacon Soup and XP as you run, and use your rewards to unlock characters, levels, weapons, costumes, and powerful upgrades.

DEFEAT THE BOSSES

Every level puts you in a chase against a unique cartoon boss. Collect weapons during your run to throw them back at that big, bad bully. Dodge attacks, manage your health, use powerups, and defeat the boss before it defeats you.

FOUR NIGHTMARISH EPISODES

Explore four original environments, each with its own boss:

• Bendy in Treasure Trouble — Dash across sandy islands, wooden docks, and pirate ships while Chester the treasure chest chases you through the tropics.

• Bendy in Death and Taxis — Race through city streets and tunnels to escape Gaskette, a taxi cab with a death wish ... yours.

• Bendy in Soup Gone Bad — Fight your way through a smelly trash dump while sharp-edged Canoodle tries to cut you down to size.

• Bendy in Dewey Decimated — Crash through a not-so-quiet library, along bookshelves and across tabletops, while inky Dewey tries to spear you with his pointy pen.

• Who else will Bendy have to escape from? More bosses and episodes to come! Stay tooned!

PLAY AS BENDY, BORIS, OR ALICE

Choose from three characters from the Bendy universe. Collect character-specific XP and Bacon Soup as you play, then use your rewards to unlock characters, discover new levels and weapons, unlock costumes, and upgrade your powerups and equipment. More beloved characters to come!

TAKE ON NIGHTMARE MODE

Complete all five levels in an episode to unlock Nightmare Mode.

Keep running and try to defeat the boss again and again, pushing your score higher until the nightmare finally consumes you.

COMPLETE OBJECTIVES

Each level includes objectives that challenge you to master your run. Collect Bacon Soup, defeat bosses without taking damage, and complete other objectives as you work towards unlocking all the good stuff.

MORE CARTOON CRAZINESS TO COME!

Get ready for endless mode, player profiles, leaderboards, new costumes, seasonal events, new episodes, new bosses and more!

A CARTOONY NIGHTMARE IN THE BENDY UNIVERSE

Bendy's Nightmare Run returns with its distinctive cartoon-themed runner gameplay, featuring Bendy, Boris, and Alice alongside original bosses and environments created specifically for Bendy's Nightmare Run.

The nightmare is waiting. How long will you survive?

apps.title: Halloween Jigcard-Puzzle Game
apps.summary:
Halloween Jigcard Puzzle – Spooky Jigsaw Card Fun!
Get ready for a spooky puzzle adventure!
Halloween Jigcard Puzzle combines the relaxing satisfaction of jigsaw puzzles with a fresh card-moving experience. Slide, match, connect, and snap puzzle cards together to reveal charming Halloween pictures filled with pumpkins, ghosts, witches, black cats, haunted houses, and more.
Every puzzle starts with scattered picture cards. Look carefully, find the matching connections, and bring the image back to life piece by piece. When the right cards snap together, enjoy that satisfying feeling of watching your Halloween picture take shape!
Whether you love jigsaw puzzles, card puzzles, or simply want a relaxing way to enjoy the Halloween season, Halloween Jigcard Puzzle offers an easy-to-learn and delightfully spooky experience.
🎃 HOW TO PLAY
- Slide the Cards
Move puzzle cards freely across the board with simple swipe controls.
- Find the Connections
Look closely at each image and discover which cards belong together.
- Match & Snap
Place matching cards next to each other and watch them snap perfectly into place.
- Build Bigger Pieces
Connected cards stay together, letting you move entire sections of the picture at once.
- Complete the Picture
Keep matching until every card comes together and the full Halloween image is revealed!
👻 GAME FEATURES
🎃 A Halloween Puzzle Adventure
Explore a collection of spooky and cozy Halloween pictures featuring glowing pumpkins, mysterious castles, friendly ghosts, witches, black cats, autumn nights, and much more.
🧩 Jigsaw Puzzle Meets Card Puzzle
Enjoy a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles. Instead of traditional puzzle pieces, move and connect picture cards to complete each scene.
✨ Satisfying Snap Moments
There is nothing better than finding the perfect match. Watch cards lock together and enjoy satisfying chain reactions as multiple pieces connect.
👉 Simple Swipe Controls
Just swipe, move, and match. The intuitive controls make it easy to start playing anytime.
🧠 Relaxing Yet Engaging
Take your time, observe the pictures, and find the right connections. No complicated rules—just relaxing puzzle-solving fun with a little Halloween mystery.
🌙 Spooky, Cozy & Beautiful Artwork
Discover atmospheric Halloween scenes ranging from cute and colorful to mysterious and magical.
🏆 Puzzles for Everyone
Easy to learn and satisfying to master, whether you're a casual puzzle player or a jigsaw fan looking for something different.
🕯️ ENTER THE HALLOWEEN WORLD
A jack-o'-lantern glowing in the night.
A black cat watching from the window.
A mysterious haunted house beneath the moon.
What picture is hiding inside the cards?
Slide the pieces, discover the connections, and reveal them all.
Download Halloween Jigcard Puzzle and start your spooky puzzle journey today!

Progressive Difficulty
- Play against opponents that grow more challenging as you improve. Start with beginner-friendly rounds, then sharpen your strategy, memory, meld-building skills, and card play over time.

apps.title: Words of Wonders: Hexa
apps.summary:
Crossword meets Hexa!

Words of Wonders Hexa (WoW Hexa) is a brand-new word puzzle from the creators of Words of Wonders, where you solve crosswords by swiping through connected hexagon tiles. It's not just what you spell — it's how you get there.

Every level gives you a honeycomb of letters. Trace a path through adjacent hexagons to form words, and each correct word snaps into the crossword above. One board, two brains: your vocabulary finds the word, your eyes find the path.

Why WoW Hexa feels different
Classic word games give you a wheel of letters — WoW Hexa gives you a hexagon board where only touching tiles connect. The same letters can hide many paths, and only the right ones spell the words you need.

Endless variety of boards
From compact honeycombs to sprawling hexagon grids, every chapter reshapes the board and resets the challenge. No two levels play the same.

Bonus words and rewards
Sharp eyes earn extra: discover hidden bonus words for coins, and use hints when a tricky crossword has you stuck.

Relax while you play
Serene landscapes, gentle animations, and no time pressure make WoW Hexa the perfect game to calm your mind while keeping it sharp.

Looking for a relaxing match-3 game with cozy home makeovers and heartwarming stories?

Swap colorful pieces, solve satisfying match-3 puzzles, earn stars, and help restore homes step by step. Each level brings you closer to a warmer, brighter space and a new story moment to discover.

Match 3, Restore Homes, Bring Stories to Life.

Swap colorful pieces and match 3 or more to clear the board and complete level goals. Make smart matches, create combos, use boosters, and clear challenging boards with satisfying chain reactions. Your puzzle progress also helps bring new warmth and comfort to each home.

🏠 Help Bring Warmth to Every Home

Each restoration journey tells a different story. Help transform worn-out homes into brighter, warmer, and more welcoming spaces as you progress through the puzzles. With every transformation, you can see how a little help can make a place feel like home again.

🧩 Relaxing Match-3 Gameplay

Enjoy classic match-3 gameplay that is easy to learn and satisfying to play. Match colorful pieces, complete level goals, create combos, and clear tricky boards with satisfying chain reactions. The difficulty gradually increases to keep each puzzle engaging while remaining easy to pick up.

💥 Boosters, Combos & Satisfying Effects

Create powerful combinations and use boosters to clear challenging boards. Trigger colorful chain reactions, make smart matches, and enjoy satisfying effects as pieces disappear and the board opens up.

✨ Restore & Transform Cozy Homes

Turn your puzzle progress into visible transformations. Bring new life to worn-out spaces and watch them become brighter, warmer, and more comfortable. Each restored home adds another heartwarming moment to the journey.

🌿 Play at Your Own Pace

Take a break with a quick puzzle or settle in for a longer session. With simple controls and familiar match-3 mechanics, you can enjoy each puzzle at your own pace while discovering new stories and home transformations.

Game Features

• Match-3 Puzzles — Match 3 or more pieces and complete level goals.

• Home Restoration — Transform worn-out homes into warm, welcoming spaces.

• Heartwarming Stories — Discover different stories behind each home.

• Boosters & Combos — Create powerful matches and clear challenging boards.

• Restoration Rewards — Complete restorations to receive boosters and coins.

• Easy-to-Learn Controls — Simple mechanics make every puzzle easy to pick up.

With SoEasy Match: Home Rescue, every match helps move a home one step closer to feeling warm and welcoming. Make your next match, complete another level, and help bring another home back to life.

apps.title: Last Human: Final Stand

The virus took everything. Cities crumble into ruins. The streets belong to the dead.
Last Human: Final Stand is a zombie shooter survival game where humanity's final defense depends on you alone — the last commander standing.

ZOMBIE SHOOTER ACTION
Pull the trigger or die. This is zombie shooting at its rawest — waves of undead
pour toward you, and every bullet counts. Aim fast, dodge faster. Massive zombie
hordes, mutated infected, brutal bosses. There is no retreat. Only survival.

it pays.

Download now. Make your final stand.

apps.title: Jewel Loop - Coloring Sort
apps.summary:
Jewel Loop - Coloring Sort blends jewel sorting with pixel art into a calming puzzle journey. Tap connected jewels of the same color and watch them glide onto a rotating loop, where they drift in circles before precisely filling the pixel canvas above. No countdowns, no rush—just a peaceful rhythm of planning and placement. As levels progress, patterns grow more intricate and colors multiply, offering an easy start with deeper layers of thoughtful strategy. The ASMR feedback of each jewel clicking into place hits right at the heart, turning every perfect match into a moment of quiet satisfaction.
Key Features
- Dual Healing: Jewel Sorting Meets Pixel Art: Every puzzle is also a creative process. From clean geometric patterns to richly detailed illustrations, each level holds a unique jewel artwork waiting to be completed.
- Collection Album: Every finished pixel artwork is automatically saved to your personal gallery. Browse through your creations anytime and revisit each calming puzzle moment.
- Daily Challenges: Fresh exclusive pattern levels arrive every day, unlocking new color palettes and jewel sets. The surprises never run out.
- Immersive ASMR Experience: Every step—jewels gliding, colors filling, artwork completing—is paired with smooth animations and delicate sound effects, turning each successful match into a truly satisfying reward.
Why You'll Love It
- Blends sorting strategy with pixel art creation—both thoughtful and creative.
- No timers—play at your own pace, but keep an eye on loop capacity.
- Every level is a complete pixel artwork you create.
- Perfect for quick sessions or longer, immersive play—find your rhythm anytime.
Ready to Sort & Color?
Download Jewel Loop - Coloring Sort. Send jewels onto the loop, fill the canvas, and complete your pixel art—one jewel at a time.

apps.title: Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort
apps.summary:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

apps.title: Ludo Go! - Dice Board Games
apps.summary:
Discover Ludo Go!, a fun board game where every dice roll brings you closer to victory! Move the pieces across the board, knock opponents back to start, and race to bring all your pieces to the finish first. The gameplay feels simple, competitive, and rewarding, blending classic ludo rules with familiar parchis-style routes, parchisi traditions, and smart tactical choices.

Looking for a fun board game that is easy to start but keeps every move interesting? This dice game gives you simple rules from the first roll while adding more depth as you progress.If you enjoy board games like ludo and parcheesi, you’ll appreciate how every level brings a new board layout, fresh challenges, and new ways to outplay your opponent. Roll the dice, choose your best move, use special tiles, and turn every race into a fun game clash!

How to play Ludo Go!:

• Roll the dice and move your pieces across the board.
• Roll a 6 to leave the starting area and enter the race.
• Land on an opponent’s tile to knock their piece back to start.
• Choose which piece to move and plan your route to the finish.
• Use bonus tiles to move forward, move back, teleport, or trigger special effects.
• Unlock unique piece abilities and make your moves even stronger.
• Bring all your pieces to the finish before your opponent to win the level.

If you’re exploring board games for free, or two player games, Ludo Go! adds a fresh level-based twist to classic dice game fun!

Why you'll love Ludo Go!:

✔ A fun dice board game with simple rules and exciting competitive gameplay.
✔ A modern ludo game with classic mechanics, fast turns, and level-based goals.
✔ Fast dice rolls, smart moves, and satisfying moments when you knock opponents back.
✔ Bonus tiles that can move pieces forward, send them back, teleport, block, or give extra effects.
✔ Unique piece abilities, including extra life, armor, speed, and sticky movement.
✔ Colorful board locations, from desert and tropical areas to snowy lands and more.
✔ New level layouts, bonus mechanics, and special tiles that appear as you progress.
✔ Easy to play, but full of tactical decisions that make every dice roll feel important.
✔ A great pick for fans of free board games, parcheesi, and quick dice games.

Play Ludo Go! Enjoy a fresh board adventure across exciting game levels and become the king of ludo game!

apps.title: Highway Heroes: Truck Manager
apps.summary:
🚚 Highway Heroes is the truck tycoon management game where strategy beats speed. Build a freight company from the ground up, plan smart routes across U.S. regions, and grow your idle tycoon empire through careful decisions — not quick reflexes. If you love a logistics game that rewards patience and planning, welcome home.

🗺️ Start with one garage and a single rig in this truck tycoon adventure. Line up hauling contracts, choose the best routes for profit and efficiency, and deliver on time to build your reputation. Every dollar earned is a decision made — reinvest in your fleet, expand your facilities, or unlock new regions. With idle tycoon earnings working for you around the clock, your company never stops growing.

🏗️ Build the infrastructure behind your logistics game empire. Add garages, service bays, and dispatch offices that directly improve turnaround time, driver reliability, and contract access. Every upgrade in this management game reshapes how your business operates — faster maintenance, smarter logistics, and bigger contracts within reach.

🎨 Customize your fleet down to the details in this truck tycoon. Choose authentic paint schemes, decals, lighting rigs, trailers, and performance parts. Clean isometric views and tidy menus make every choice easy to read and satisfying to make — even on smaller screens. The idle tycoon system lets your customized trucks earn while you plan your next move.

📦 Master the logistics game at the heart of Highway Heroes. Match the right loads to the right trucks, schedule around weather and distance, and keep fuel costs and repairs under control. Managing contracts in this truck tycoon feels like running a real business: orderly, fair, and deeply satisfying.

🛻 Collect iconic American haulers in this management game. From classic rigs to modern workhorses, each truck unlocks new routes and contract types. This is a logistics game where your collection has real strategic value — not just cosmetic appeal. Every truck you add strengthens your fleet with new cargo options and better efficiency across regions.

👀 See everything at a glance. Crisp isometric angles, clear icons, and legible text make complex decisions feel simple. Whether you're a veteran truck tycoon player or new to this kind of management game, Highway Heroes is designed for clarity over clutter. The idle tycoon mechanics keep your company running smoothly, so you can check in on your terms.

🇺🇸 Begin in the United States and expand region by region. Hire dependable drivers, upgrade your headquarters, and become a true trucking mogul. With idle tycoon earnings funding your growth, a deep logistics game driving every decision, and a management game built for thinkers — this truck tycoon is the road to take.

apps.title: Last Shelter: War Z
apps.summary:
The last bastion of humanity has fallen. As the Commander of a final group of survivors, you face a grim new world in the aftermath of doomsday. You hid in an abandoned underground shelter. You must venture into the unknown, reclaim the wasteland, and eradicate the zombie horde. Build your underground stronghold, but remember: survival demands more than walls—it requires expansion, exploration, and relentless combat.​

【BUILD YOUR SURVIVAL SHELTER】
Your underground fortress is the heart of your resistance. Build and customize every room—from Power Generators and Research Labs to Control Centers. Upgrade your facilities to unlock advanced weapons. Design your layout with tactical strategy, because this isn't just a home, it's a war base that fuels your fight to reclaim the world.

【EXPLORE & COLLECT UNDERGROUND】
The real adventure lies in the darkness. Send elite squads into unexplored tunnels and the desolate wastelands shown on your map. Scavenge for vital resources, uncover lost technology, and undertake critical missions to rescue other survivors and search for a cure​ under the zombie horde. Every expedition is a high-stakes mission: stay vigilant—zombies lurk everywhere, and danger strikes without warning.

【FIGHT ZOMBIES】
Combat is brutal and constant. Face off against zombie swarms, terrifying mutant bosses, and other enemy threats lurking in the shadows. Assemble a team of unique heroes, master their powerful abilities, and devise tactical formations to crush your enemies in intense battle. Engage in clashes where you must shoot, fight with guns, and survive enemy fire.

【BASE DEFENSE & TOWER TACTICS】
Your shelter is a prize coveted by all. Defend it from waves of zombies and raids from rival commanders! Construct defensive fortifications, lay cunning traps, and strategically place guard towers to create an impenetrable fortress. Use your radar to detect incoming enemy​ hordes and plan your strategy.

【FORM ALLIANCES FOR DOMINANCE​】
Forge powerful alliances with other players to conquer the wasteland together. Coordinate attacks, share resources, and participate in large-scale alliance wars to dominate the ruined cityscapes. Victory in this endless war belongs to those who unite.

Last Shelter: War Z offers a rich, strategic survival experience with a focus on exploration, combat, and cooperation. The apocalypse was the end of the world, but this is the start of yours. Will you lead humanity to rebirth? Download now and begin your underground odyssey!

apps.title: Narco Empire
apps.summary:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

Disclaimer: This game is a work of fiction. All substances, events, and characters portrayed are fictional. Please play responsibly.

apps.title: Kanji: Japanese Word Search
apps.summary:
Kanji Search turns time with kanji into a puzzle you'll actually want to play — think classic Word Search, but with kanji.

Love Japanese, or learning it? It's a relaxing way to meet real kanji every day — and a satisfying brain-teaser if you just love puzzles.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every board gives you a set of target kanji and a grid of components. Swipe to connect the right pieces and complete each kanji — easy to pick up, satisfying to master. As you find one, you see its meaning and watch it drawn stroke by stroke, so you absorb real Japanese while you play.

WRITE IT, DON'T JUST FIND IT
Learn to write kanji — not just recognize them. Tap any kanji you've found to open the practice pad and trace it stroke by stroke over a guide, in the correct order and direction. Draw a stroke right in one clean pass and it locks in; miss and it resets — so the shape really sticks. Going from finding a word to writing it is where kanji start to feel like yours.

A QUICK EXAMPLE
森 "forest" = 木 + 木 + 木 (three trees). 休 "rest" = 亻 (person) + 木 (tree). Every kanji breaks into pieces like these — find them on the grid.

FOR ENTHUSIASTS & LEARNERS
• Real kanji with their meanings
• Stroke-by-stroke order for every kanji
• Spans JLPT levels, school grades, radicals and frequency

FOUR DIFFICULTIES
From breezy Easy boards to brain-bending Insane, there's a challenge for every level — whether you're prepping for the JLPT or just unwinding.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of kanji to discover
• Drag-to-find, word-search-style gameplay
• Trace-to-write practice — draw each kanji stroke by stroke, in order
• Meaning and stroke-order clue cards — toggle anytime
• Achievements and cloud save to track your progress
• Fully offline — no account, no internet needed
• Free to play, with an optional ad-free upgrade

Whether you're studying for the JLPT, brushing up your kanji, or simply after a calm, clever puzzle, Kanji Search makes every match a tiny lesson.

Download and start finding — and writing — kanji today.
